entries.0cc8fd4c68e8992e: Consolidated subsidiary Nihon Software Hanbai Co., Ltd. develops and sells systems for sekkotsuin clinics. The patient information management system “Ligoo POS & CRM” and the receipt calculation system “Rese ONE” were transferred to Smaregi, Inc. effective May 1, 2024. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥215 million.
entries.15f0e4da72a573f8: A business that supports the management and operation of sekkotsuin and seikotsuin clinics. It develops and sells systems for sekkotsuin clinics, sells treatment equipment and consumables, provides management consulting, handles reimbursement claims, and sells health-related products using IFMC. minute mineral crystals. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,773 million.
entries.24bf2404abe1ceef: A business in which consolidated subsidiary FP Design Co., Ltd. operates an insurance agency and provides management support. It operates an insurance agency with outsourcing agreements with 23 life insurance companies and 9 non-life insurance companies, and provides management support, including financial consulting and M&A brokerage. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥645 million.
entries.405f19e19c89d2fc: It sells equipment and consumables that support self-pay treatment menus at sekkotsuin clinics. In addition to the electrical muscle stimulation device “EMS-indepth-,” the hydraulic electric treatment table “Thomson Bed,” and the low-frequency therapy device “Inject Energy,” it handles consumables such as adhesive pads. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥199 million.
entries.4d0df2cd4082cb91: Operates a wellness business that supports the management of bonesetter clinics (sekkotsuin) and a financial business that includes insurance agencies and other operations.
entries.6872445737fc5529: Development and sales of systems for sekkotsuin clinics
entries.8f0c51d705462bc2: FP Design Co., Ltd. has outsourcing agreements with 23 life insurance companies and 9 non-life insurance companies (as of the end of March 2026), and solicits various types of insurance as an insurance agency. Solicitation is mainly through referrals from the company group and partner companies. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥521 million.
entries.bcde564215b7bc49: Consolidated subsidiary Healthcare Fit Co., Ltd. provides a reimbursement claims agency service to reduce the administrative burden on sekkotsuin clinics, and an early reimbursement payment service that lends funds for the period until reimbursement is received. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥402 million.
entries.bcfbca8e92c5c18e: A business in which FP Design Co., Ltd. had outsourcing agreements with four securities companies and proposed and intermediated financial products. Following the transfer of all of the company’s shares on August 1, 2025, the financial instruments intermediary business ended. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, operations covered April to July 2025, and revenue was ¥58 million.
entries.f5de8d34a03e85cc: FP Design Co., Ltd. provides management support services to business companies, centering on financial consulting and M&A brokerage. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥65 million.
